verdict.rationale: Netlify is a cloud hosting platform, so offering a managed Redis-compatible store is a fair question. The evidence shows only a blob store accessed via getStore, managed Postgres and a Turso integration. None of these is described as Redis-compatible or as supporting low-latency caching or job queues, so they are adjacent features rather than this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a Redis-compatible key-value store for low-latency caching and job queues
